# DIGITAL SALES ROOMS

## Better buyer engagementstarts here

Give sellers and buyers a secure, centralized space to collaborate, share content, and track engagement that helps move deals faster.

[Talk with our AI Agent](https://www.seismic.com/summer-ai-chat/ "Talk with our AI Agent")

![image-products-digital-sales-rooms-hero-2x](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63874-image-products-digital-sales-rooms-hero-2x%3Fv%3D11bef8c3&w=3840&q=75)

![image-products-digital-sales-rooms-overlaycard](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63875-image-products-digital-sales-rooms-overlaycard%3Fv%3D5fbabe4d&w=384&q=75)

![Hero-curve-line-purple](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F61955-hero-curve-line-purple%3Fv%3D85e1d1e6&w=1080&q=75)

What can digital sales room software do for you?

Today’s sales cycles require more conversations, more stakeholders, and more information than ever. Simplify the experience with a secure, centralized space that’s designed to accelerate deals.

![image-products-digital-sales-rooms-deep-dive-2x](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63840-image-products-digital-sales-rooms-deep-dive-2x%3Fv%3D143b0097&w=3840&q=75)

![Seismic-Icon-Monitor-People-Dawn3-Filled-64px](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F66637-seismic-icon-monitor-people-dawn3-filled-64px%3Fv%3Ddca183c6&w=3840&q=75)

Improve the buyer experience

Attract buyers and keep them engaged throughout the deal cycle with personalized video recordings, tailored content, and timely insights.

![Seismic-Icon-Accelerate-Dawn3-Filled-64px](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F64900-seismic-icon-accelerate-dawn3-filled-64px%3Fv%3De50a0828&w=3840&q=75)

Accelerate deals

Centralize all relevant content for buying teams and give them the ability to comment, reply to threads, and tag colleagues as needed.

![Seismic-Icon-DocGraph-Search-Dawn3-Filled-64px](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F65689-seismic-icon-docgraph-search-dawn3-filled-64px%3Fv%3D70f3380f&w=3840&q=75)

Get detailed insights

Receive alerts with detailed insights into what specifically buyers engage with, so you can deliver timely, relevant follow-ups and messaging.

Personalize

Enable personalized content delivery with an easy-to-use, drag-and-drop design tool. Stand out from the crowd and win buyers’ attention with video intros that add a personal touch, easily recorded right within the Digital Sales Room.

![image-personalize-2x](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63839-image-personalize-2x%3Fv%3Dc8651e55&w=3840&q=75)

Centralize

Accelerate deal cycles by providing a single source of truth for all stakeholders. As deals progress, reps update Digital Sales Rooms with relevant information that keeps buyers engaged with features like tagging, commenting, and posting questions.

![image-centralize-2x](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63838-image-centralize-2x%3Fv%3Da68ce7ca&w=3840&q=75)

Scale

Empower reps to easily create best-in-class client experiences. Seismic’s Digital Sales Room features give marketing and enablement teams control over the branding, messaging, and content in a scalable way.

![image-scale-2x](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63877-image-scale-2x%3Fv%3Dc2245a0a&w=3840&q=75)

Stay secure

Trust that only the right people have access to your deal information with a secure login. Ensure that all engagements adhere to global privacy management requirements with custom buyer privacy settings.

![image-stay-secure-2x](https://www.seismic.com/_next/image/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fassets.seismic.com%2Fapi%2Fpublic%2Fcontent%2F63873-image-stay-secure-2x%3Fv%3D27fea7ae&w=2048&q=75)

A powerful AI sales enablement platform that grows with you

Seismic’s enterprise-grade platform empowers teams with fast and flexible digital selling tools that drive better experiences across the buyer journey.

FAQs about Digital Sales Rooms

How do Seismic's Digital sales rooms accelerate deals?

Seismic's Digital Sales Rooms streamline the buyer journey by providing a centralized, personalized digital workspace for sellers and buyers to collaborate, engage with content, and make decisions faster — all within one secure virtual deal room.

Can I personalize the content and branding within a DSR?

Yes! Seismic’s digital sales rooms let you customize branding, messaging, and content to create more engaging, trustworthy buyer experiences online.

How does Seismic track engagement within a Digital Sales Room?

With Seismic’s Digital Sales Rooms, sellers can see how buyers engage with content in real time—so they can follow up smarter and close deals faster.

Are Seismic’s Digital Sales Rooms secure?

Yes, Seismic’s Digital Sales Rooms offer secure document sharing with access controls like password protection—buyers don’t need a Seismic account to view content, making the experience seamless and secure.

What makes Seismic’s DSRs different from other virtual sales room platforms?

Seismic’s Digital Sales Rooms are built on a leading sales enablement platform — bringing together personalized content, collaboration, and analytics for a more effective selling experience.
